a.text: How many more times must we see this?
Newly-sprouted seedlings, stalks bending from the weight of grain, branches filled with fruit... all gone before Catastrophe.
Frost in early spring almost wiped out the seedlings. It took all our effort to preserve a small portion of them.
What will it take to feed everyone?

steps.text: A sudden rain has drowned any festive spirit.
The rain begins to subside, but not the water accumulated in the fields, which has reached ankle depth.

steps.name: Anxious Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: How could so much water accumulate so quickly?!

steps.name: Anxious Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: It's turbid... did the rain carry dirty mud from upstream? It's going to pollute the fields!

steps.name: Anxious Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: Gai si de! What are they doing at the construction site? Drain the damned thing already!

steps.name: Panicking Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: This is bad! The dam's burst!

steps.name: Anxious Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: Ta ma de! You've gotta be kidding me!

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Young Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Apparently, an Originium vein upstream exploded, sending fragments down the river that got caught in the machinery, blowing a hole in the dam.

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Why didn't anyone notice?!

steps.name: Young Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: The water levels were normal. We didn't detect any unusual Originium reactions, or expect the Originium activity to be so irregular...

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Jiangui de... during flood season, no less.

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: The water is filled with Originium silt. It's going to wreak havoc on the crops, maybe even cause infection.

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Everyone be careful! Dam repairs will take time. Get people downstream to block the flow!

steps.name: Young Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: The current is getting faster. What do we do if the entire dam collapses?

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: What do you think we can do? Stop it with your Arts, your lives!
The polluted water continues to spread. The fields are already filled with mud.

steps.name: Frantic Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: Step on it! More sandbags!

steps.name: Frantic Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: We need to protect the experiments in this field! Don't let it get flooded!

steps.name: Frantic Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: Aiya! Your specialty is playing with sand, isn't it? Get to it!

steps.name: Agitated Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: You're the one who plays with sand! My specialty is soil analysis! Ai, I'll do what I can!
Farmers and Tianshis line up to deliver sandbag after sandbag to the banks, scrapping together a makeshift dam with Originium Arts.
There is one last gap in it.

steps.name: Agitated Nongye Tianshi
steps.text: Gah... I can't...
The youth leaps up with a bag of sand in his arms and tries to block the gap, but a gust of wind stops him in his tracks.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: What are you doing?!

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: That water is mixed with Originium-filled mud! Are you trying to get infected?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It's my job to protect the people...

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: You think everyone needs your protection? You're different from the people standing here because why?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: How can I help?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The flood is caused by a burst dam. It's overwhelmed the field's drainage system.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: We're in flood season, and it'll take time to repair it. The situation will only get worse if we don't do something.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: You're a Messenger, right? Are you fast?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I suppose... what do you need me to do?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Someone needs to take charge in this chaos.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Take this map and go to the marked plates. Find the farmer in charge and get the plates ready to move.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What are you planning?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Dahuang's nomadic city modifications are only partially complete, but some degree of movement is possible.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: While repairs at the dam continue, we will rebuild the drainage system by rearranging the plates and creating elevation...

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Gah—
The edges of the metal plate melt as they connect to the gap in the dam.
The flood, seeking the path of least resistance, continues to batter the hasty repair. Water shoots out from the gaps in the metal, cutting open a crack like sharp blades.

steps.name: Young Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: That's not how your Arts are supposed to be used, Laoshi! You need to rest. I'll take over for a while.

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Back off!

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Your Arts are no good, child!

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: *cough*... *cough*...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Heavenly forge—

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Nian...!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: What's this mess? We aren't even done at the factory...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: But looking at this flood... good job holding out this long.

steps.name: Veteran Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: You should not intervene outside of work in the core city.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Call it emergency discretion, alright? Seriously, you engineers are even more uptight than the Sui Regulator.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Go catch your breath. I'll deal with the rest.

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: You intend to rearrange the plates?

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: No time to explain. I know work on Dahuang's mobile plates is incomplete, but they're capable of basic movement.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Moving a few plates will go a long way towards draining the polluted water in the fields.

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: You can't be serious! Only Rong and Tianshi Shu have the authority to move the plates. No one else may—

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Both of them are busy coordinating flood control efforts.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: The flood shows no sign of abating. Fields and crops are being drowned as we speak. What are you going to do, hold a Tianshi Bureau meeting?

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Why you—

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: You're Tianshi Shu's apprentice... I've seen you with her.

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Very well... I'll trust you.

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: But they are plates of various sizes, and there are dozens. Any movement is a complex job that will take several Tianshis an entire day to calculate.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: No need for that. I have the layout memorized, and a plan.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: This is what we'll do.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Plate A-9, five tiles to the east. Plate B-8, down five levels.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: What are you doing standing there? Get on it!

steps.name: Tumu Tianshi
steps.text: Ai! Fine, I don't have any better ideas.

steps.name: Alarmed Farmer
steps.text: What's going on? The plate is moving!

steps.name: Alarmed Farmer
steps.text: Wait, the flood seems to have gotten weaker...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The plates are moving! Seek shelter—

steps.name: Alarmed Farmer
steps.text: Seek shelter where? The greenhouses?

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Calm down and evacuate through the passage to Plate C-4. It's at a higher elevation now and gives protection from the floods.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Qingping! What are you doing here?

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: I saw He Sheng and he told me what he's planning.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: The river is to the north of Dahuang. The plates to the west are the ones that have to be moved in order to drain the water from the northwest side of Dahuang to the valley in the southwest.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I didn't think of that at all...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Mianmian! Stay put!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Grain Buds?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Candlestick, Inkbrush! What about Big Buffalo? Is he okay?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: He...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Don't worry, he's in a safe place.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Oh, I'm so relieved!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Wait, no, that's not it! The stockbeasts ran away in panic when the plate started moving. Help me catch them!

steps.name: Frightened Stockbeasts
steps.text: (Terrified cries)

steps.name: Anxious Farmer
steps.text: Where did these stockbeasts come from?!

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Mianmian! No running!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Stop! That's the edge of the plate!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Dusk?!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Who permitted you to use your powers—

steps.name: Feminine Voice
steps.text: Slowpokes.

steps.name: Feminine Voice
steps.text: Going door to door like this, half the houses will be flooded by the time you reach them.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Feminine Voice
steps.text: Never thought I would be helping the Sui Regulator clean up their mess... I'll do it this once. Won't happen again.

steps.name: Anxious Farmer
steps.text: Wh-Where are we? Tianshi Arts? Who could be so powerful?

steps.name: Astonished Farmer
steps.text: Look!

steps.name: Astonished Farmer
steps.text: The sky's clearing up...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Everyone's exhausted. Dahuang can't afford another disaster.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: I suppose this qualifies as extenuating circumstances.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Go away.
A breeze sweeps across the land.
Vast expanses of farmland undulate like breathing, cutting the surging torrent into smaller streams that flow along planned routes.
Standing on the edge of the plate, the lucky stockbeast watches the flood subside, then digs out a patch of clean grass with its nose and begins to eat.
The sun shines through the clouds, upon a land that has survived disaster—barely.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: Plates A-9 through C-3 successfully moved. All accumulated water is now being drained.

steps.name: He Sheng
steps.text: End of report.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: What is the extent of the damage?

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: Varying levels of pollution on Plates A-9 through B-3. Less impact to the other plates, but further inspections are called for.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: Crops from polluted fields must be disposed of. The summer harvest will be significantly impacted, on top of a year that has already seen disappointing results.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Almost a year of the people's hard work washed away... will there be enough to fill this year's quota?

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: How many will go hungry?

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: There will be enough, thanks to the efforts of countless generations.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: But we can't afford another surprise.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: This is bigger than just Dahuang. We must report to the capital and coordinate food supplies across all of Yan.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Yumen is closest to Dahuang, but it was also struck by Catastrophe earlier this year. Repairs are still ongoing, and it's unlikely they could spare anyone.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Indeed. The Ministry of Works indicates that Catastrophe frequency has been rising in recent years.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: This has been a bad year...

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: Dahuang is already the country's biggest food producer. We can't ask for aid from other cities.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: Plate repairs can wait. Dahuang's first priority is food production. There are still many experimental fields close to bearing fruit that have not yet been moved to safer plates...

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: We'll need to delay work on the Twelve Pagodas and Five Cities. We need to bring back the Tianshis who were reassigned there to save the remaining farms and grain.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: We can't afford to delay the summer planting.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: I understand your difficulties, but can we not discuss a delay of the Twelve Pagodas and Five Cities?

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Food is important, of course, but the Twelve Pagodas and Five Cities is also an important national defense project. The imperial court has reason to order it completed by autumn. We must consider the benefits and drawbacks carefully.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: You want to consider it carefully, you'll write to the capital, have the Council of Ministers meet for ten days, and come back to us with a result.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: A food shortfall doesn't mean people pay a few more coins to buy their grain.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: It means that many thousands will go hungry.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: How many will be driven from their homes if there is a war?

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Never forget where the Twelve Pagodas and Five Cities project came from.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: Across the river...

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: You know it's more than that.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Beyond the issue with demons, there is—

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: This is not the right time or place for this topic.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: Watch your words.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: Gai si.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: It's not easy to quantify benefits and drawbacks, but our priority is clear.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: The summer harvest and planting involve years of research and food for millions. There can be no delay.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: We should ask the Tianshis to help inspect and repair affected areas. This is our immediate priority.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: As for the schedule of the Twelve Pagodas and Five Cities, I'll request instructions from the Tianshi Bureaus in the name of the Ministry of Rites. Perhaps something can be done, with the help of the Chamber of Heaven's Designs.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: I'll take responsibility if the imperial court determines that the matter was not properly handled.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: Well, if they want to chop someone's head off, they can make it mine. Just say I put a sword to the Assistant Minister's neck here. You stay out of this.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: How do we get anything done, if we're already talking about responsibility before we've gotten any work done?

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: It's the people of Yan who will pay the price for a mistake. We're merely three insignificant specimens thereof.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: If both of you insist... I will defer to your decision.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: I ask that you remember the promises you just made.

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: No problem. Everything goes well, everyone's happy. Things go wrong, you can pin it all on me.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Er, that's not what I meant. All I meant to say is that, given the urgency of the situation, it would be prudent to communicate with the Chamber of Heaven's Designs—

steps.name: Old Xiangzhang
steps.text: I most certainly concur. I will draft a detailed report for Assistant Minister Ning to deliver to the Chamber.

steps.name: Ning Ciqiu
steps.text: I'll need to prepare for that. I take my leave.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Excuse me, ladies—eh.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Well, at least my Ministry of Works won't be taking the fall.

steps.name: Assistant Minister Wan
steps.text: Let's hope the supplies arrive on time.
Kick and roll... kick and roll...
Grain Buds absent-mindedly kicks the dirt in the fields.
The lumps roll haphazardly, while Grain Buds walks with her head bowed, swinging wild grass that she picked from the roadside.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Wonder how long the power outage might last this time. It's so hot, and the stockbeasts are scared. Disease could spread too...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: They're not eating or sleeping. Are they comfortable in their new home?

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Xiaohe, too. Haven't seen him at dinner for days. Doesn't he know that he needs to rest when tired? He's dumber than a burdenbeast...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: The weather is getting worse each year, and the crops don't grow well...

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Has Shennong really abandoned this land?
She winds the grass around her finger, then rolls it up.
She makes a motion to throw it, then she remembers how Shu weaved the grass into a foal with a few deft movements of her fingers.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: Shu could make so many things if I brought this grass back. But she's so busy, and even Candlestick is nowhere to be seen.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: I guess I should bring some more back and weave it up. Maybe it'll make them happier.

steps.name: Grain Buds
steps.text: And where the heck is Mianmian?
Grain Buds lifts her feet and kicks a piece of dirt hard.
It hits a rice stalk, spins, and comes to a stop.
Splat.
It leaves no mark on the rice stalk.
A flood.
The crops in the fields bow their heads, just like everyone has.
Only a single rice plant stands tall in the carnage.
It holds its grains high and proud, almost in scorn of everything else that has fallen, as though it has absorbed the lifeforce of everything around it.
When everything else goes dark, it alone blooms bright like life.
Grain Buds could not resist reaching out to touch it.
It is bright red.
A burdenbeast strolls by the edge of the paddies, the sun shining upon it.
It is bright red too.
Here at last.
The tired one closes her reddened eyes.
The river has drowned her mouth, the mud glued her eyes shut. Trees and weeds sway lifelessly in the wind, and she tries her hardest to identify the sound.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: Sigh...
She brushes her hand against a fallen seedling, and it stands back up in the mud, enervated.
She closes her eyes. The river flows past her hair, and the roots of the trees are like lines on her palm.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: There was a time, many years ago, when Catastrophes were frequent as they are now...

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: There was nothing I could do. I watched as rice ready for harvest fell in the fields, leaving nothing but a tiny patch that could barely fill a single bag.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You said to me, your face full of mud, that there was nothing to worry about. Keep at it, year after year, and it will come.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: There were no wrinkles on your face back then.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: And you weren't Shennong yet.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: So many years have passed. Why is the dream still so distant?
The earth beneath her feet undulates like her breathing, as though there is a warm heart deep below that continues to beat, slowly and heavily.
Now its shallow footsteps become recognizable.
The rumble of motor vehicles, only heard once every few months.
Caravans from afar deliver new supplies, new things, and news from other places, bringing some excitement to the life of monotonous labor in Dahuang.
It does not take long for the dust cloud to close the distance, and a figure comes down from the lead vehicle.
He is wearing a light, spotless shirt, and wind and smoke follow him for ten thousand li.

steps.name: Shu
steps.text: You're back.

steps.name: Elegant Man
steps.text: Long time no see.

steps.name: Elegant Man
steps.text: My dear sister.
